description: Replication Data for: Damage to dykes and levees in The Netherlands is extensive and increases with Muskrat (Ondatra zibethicus) density is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Ron Ydenberg, Emiel van Loon. This dataset consists of R-scripts and associated data files in .txt, .csv, .rda and .rds formats. Coverage: national (NL); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
